outgoing.name: Arctic Ocean
outgoing.excerpt: The object is named after Sedna, the Inuit goddess of the sea, who was believed to live in the cold depths of the Arctic Ocean.

outgoing.name: Chile
outgoing.excerpt: Observations from Chile show that Sedna is one of the reddest objects in the solar system, nearly as red as Mars.
